left-atrium: Receives oxygen-rich blood from the lungs
right-atrium: Receives used blood from the body
left-ventricle: The thickest-walled chamber, pumping blood to the whole body
incisor: The flat cutting teeth at the front
premolar: The two-cusped teeth just behind the pointed ones
molar: The broad grinding teeth at the back, wisdom teeth included
malleus: Attached to the eardrum; shaped like a mallet
incus: The middle link of the chain, shaped like a blacksmith's block
stapes: The last link of the chain, and the smallest bone in the body
ring-finger: Where a wedding band usually goes
little-finger: The smallest digit; raised when sipping tea
artery: Carries blood away from the heart
vein: Carries blood back to the heart
capillary: The tiniest vessel, where oxygen passes into tissue
frontal-lobe: At the front: planning, decisions and personality
parietal-lobe: At the top: touch and spatial sense
temporal-lobe: At the sides: hearing and memory
